001package pkg_entities;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.Random;
005
006/**
007 * Special room that teleports the player to one of several target rooms.
008 *
009 * <p>In test mode, the destination can be forced by room id so scripted test files can make the
010 * teleporter deterministic.
011 *
012 * @author Barnabe Jouanard
013 * @version 2026.05.08
014 */
015public class TransporterRoom extends Room {
016    /** Rooms that can be selected as random teleport destinations. */
017    private Room[] aTargetRooms;
018
019    /** Optional fixed destination used by the {@code alea} test command. */
020    private Room aForcedRoom;
021
022    /**
023     * Creates a transporter room with its display assets and possible targets.
024     *
025     * @param pDescription room description shown to the player
026     * @param pImage room image filename
027     * @param pMapImage map image filename
028     * @param pTargetRooms destinations available to the teleporter
029     */
030    public TransporterRoom(final String pDescription,final String pImage,final String pMapImage,final ArrayList<Room> pTargetRooms) {
031        super(pDescription, pImage, pMapImage);
032        this.aTargetRooms = pTargetRooms.toArray(new Room[0]);
033        this.aForcedRoom = null;
034    }
035
036    /**
037     * Returns either the forced destination or a random destination.
038     *
039     * @return the selected destination room
040     */
041    public Room getRandomRoom() {
042        if (this.aForcedRoom != null) {
043            return this.aForcedRoom;
044        }
045        Random vRandom = new Random();
046        return this.aTargetRooms[vRandom.nextInt(this.aTargetRooms.length)];
047    } // getRandomRoom()
048
049    /**
050     * Forces the teleporter to send the player to a specific room id.
051     *
052     * @param pRoom the room id, or any unknown value to clear the forced room
053     */
054    public void setForcedRoom(final String pRoom) {
055        switch (pRoom) {
056            case "house":
057                this.aForcedRoom = this.aTargetRooms[0];
058                break;
059            case "littleroot":
060                this.aForcedRoom = this.aTargetRooms[1];
061                break;
062            case "route101":
063                this.aForcedRoom = this.aTargetRooms[2];
064                break;
065            case "oldale":
066                this.aForcedRoom = this.aTargetRooms[3];
067                break;
068            case "route102":
069                this.aForcedRoom = this.aTargetRooms[4];
070                break;
071            case "petalburg":
072                this.aForcedRoom = this.aTargetRooms[5];
073                break;
074            case "petalburgWoods":
075                this.aForcedRoom = this.aTargetRooms[6];
076                break;
077            case "rustboro":
078                this.aForcedRoom = this.aTargetRooms[7];
079                break;
080            default:
081                this.aForcedRoom = null;
082    }
083    } // setForcedRoom()
084
085    /** Clears the forced destination so the teleporter becomes random again. */
086    public void resetForcedRoom() {
087        this.aForcedRoom = null;
088    } // resetForcedRoom()
089}
